_comment: Static drift rules (EN/BM/ZH/TA). Patterns must be valid in BOTH Python re and JavaScript RegExp (no lookbehind, no named groups) because `dtam_harness.py sync --write` copies them into the HTML apps. Parametric rules (GCP score, total n, pilot n, supervisor names) are generated in code from dtam_constants.json. severity: error = must fix; warn = human confirmation; info = tracked flag.
